$comment: The standard catalogue (spec §4, feedback cycle 01 F4).
This is NOT a trip. It defines the checklist categories every Jugni uses, and
the items most trips want, so 'pack a shaver' is remembered by default rather
than only when the agent happens to think of it.
input.json may ADD to a trip and may suppress an instantiated item, but it
cannot redefine a category or rewrite a default's text. That is what keeps the
catalogue authoritative while the traveller's own list stays theirs.
appliesTo decides whether an item is instantiated for a given trip:
persona:<id>      the primary traveller has that need profile (spec §5)
country:<name|cc> the trip visits that country
lat:>60 / lat:<n  any city above/below that latitude — a proxy for far north
cities:<n>        the trip has at least n cities
nights:<n>        the trip is at least n nights long
dueOffset is days BEFORE departure, since the catalogue cannot know dates.

checklistDefaults.task: Check passport validity — 6 months past your return, 2 blank pages
Check visa or entry requirements for every country on the route
Buy travel insurance
Save offline copies of passport, tickets and bookings
Leave your itinerary with someone at home
Tell the bank your travel dates and check foreign transaction fees
Get a small amount of local cash for arrival
Pack a backup card, stored separately from your main one
Agree a daily spending target
Check in online for your first flight
Sort airport transfers at both ends
Review free-cancellation deadlines before they pass
Compare a transit pass against single tickets in each city
Confirm every city-to-city leg is actually booked
Pack plug adapters for every country on the route
Pack a daypack
Pack a rain shell
Pack thermal base layers, gloves and a beanie
checklistDefaults.note: The route goes far enough north for this to matter.

checklistDefaults.task: Pack a padlock for hostel lockers
Pack broken-in walking boots
Plan laundry — pack for a week, not for the whole trip
Pack general medicine — painkillers, antihistamine, upset stomach, blister plasters
Pack prescriptions in original packaging, with a copy of the script
Pack shaver and toiletries
Pack sunscreen and lip balm
Check whether any vaccinations are needed
Sort a local eSIM or roaming plan
Pack chargers, cables and a power bank
Download offline maps for every city
Set photos to back up automatically over wifi
Look up last trains and night buses in each city
Check whether any hikes or parks need permits booked ahead
Find certified or suitable places to eat in each city
Verify step-free routes and accessible entrances for planned stops
Check quiet hours and booking rules for spas and baths
Plan around nap and meal timing for each travel day
